rules.rule:
Specialized optimization directives for modules/agent_ui.py (Terminal UI, Spinners, Session Box, Key Reading).
DO NOT FLAG: (1) Declarative BOX_SPECS / BOX_STYLES mapping and build_dynamic_box() grid generator; (2) Precomputed static _WAVE_PATTERN in CalmBoatSpinner, docking layout on leave_on_screen, and batched style-grouping in _glimmer; (3) Non-flushing multi-packet escape byte buffering with TCSADRAIN in _read_fd(); (4) Non-blocking wake_on_key fade-in animation using select.select on sys.stdin in draw_session_box(); (5) 30s TTL memoization on get_local_model_name() to prevent render stalls; (6) Delta-calculated line-rewind ANSI escapes (\033[{last_rendered_lines}A\r\033[J) in select_workspace_profile(); (7) Explicit EOF and KeyboardInterrupt guards in interactive loops; (8) Threading stop_event in InlineSpinner; (9) Gated first-frame cursor rewinds (rewind = '' if first_frame else ...) in draw_session_box(); (10) Direct ternary styling in render_fade_frame() without glyph memoization caches; (11) Word-boundary matching (re.search(r'\bsystem\b', ...)) in run_interactive_selection().
PRIORITIZE: (1) Precomputing static regex patterns and ANSI color escape constants.
DO NOT SACRIFICE: (1) Raw termios single-key reading; (2) Guaranteed cursor restoration (\033[?25h) in finally blocks; (3) Clean error propagation.

Specialized optimization directives for modules/agent_stream.py (Streaming SSE, ANSI Geometry & Rich Streamer).
DO NOT FLAG: (1) TerminalLayout vertical rhythm sentinel (gap(), to(), record_newlines(), and layout.gap(2) on interrupted thinking blocks); (2) Subclassing Markdown as AgentMarkdown with in-place line segment trimming in CleanCodeBlock; (3) rich.cells.cell_len() line-width calculation and terminal viewport height clamping in get_cursor_up_count(); (4) Multi-line code keyword threshold in prepare_markdown(); (5) Instance-cached self.show_thinking on RichStreamer; (6) Thinking gutter rail (│) and dynamic cell_len word-buffer wrapping in _stream_think_token(); (7) Multi-marker checking in TOOL_MARKERS with paired tags in RE_TOOL_CALL_BLOCK; (8) List chunk accumulators (_acc_think_parts, _acc_ans_parts) with property accessors preventing quadratic string copy; (9) 10s TTL memoization on _get_code_theme() avoiding global state locks per code block; (10) RichStreamer.stop() skipping trailing \r\n when render_md is True to prevent breaking 2-pass cursor-up repaints in agent_core; (11) Preserving parts[0] pre-tag tokens in in_post_think; (12) Unconditional self.phase = 'ANSWER' in _close_think_block(); (13) Trailing remainder recursion via self.update(rem) on tool end tags.
PRIORITIZE: (1) Fast token passing in _process_stream_chunk without redundant string copying.
DO NOT SACRIFICE: Viewport clamping math, vertical rhythm invariants, or accurate stream phase transitions.

Specialized optimization directives for modules/agent_core.py (Agentic Turn Loop & Stream Parsing).
DO NOT FLAG: (1) Unified _handle_sse_payload handling both stream loop and trailing unbuffered events; (2) Passing healed_args_list directly to tool execution without json.loads round-trips; (3) Explicit prefix checks on [denied] User declined/Action cancelled to avoid false-positive content aborts; (4) Dynamic rem_clock socket timeout calculation respecting turn wall-clock limits; (5) Post-prune _sanitize_tool_history() ensuring assistant tool_calls and tool results stay paired; (6) Stripping ANSI/control sequences from HTTP error bodies; (7) _heal_tool_args() contract returning dict mappings with _parse_error on invalid inputs; (8) Thread-local requests.Session pooling; (9) Generic stream exception teardown calling streamer.stop(interrupted=True); (10) Index-less tool-call delta resolution matching on tc.id or latest active index; (11) Gating Markdown re-render strictly on raw_lines < rows - 1 to prevent double rendering long replies; (12) ValueError exception guard on os.path.commonpath in run_mod().
PRIORITIZE: (1) Fast token estimation shortcuts before falling back to full iteration; (2) Compact error logging without duplicating stack unwinds.
DO NOT TOUCH: (1) Security confirmation gates; (2) Mandatory tool-call/result pairing integrity.

Specialized optimization directives for modules/agent_adapters.py (Self-Healing Parser & Argument Adapter).
DO NOT FLAG: (1) Multi-pass fallback architecture (direct JSON -> markdown fence unwrap -> XML tag strip -> heredoc parser -> regex); (2) Intentional relaxed regexes designed to tolerate broken SLM output formats; (3) Extracting only the first contiguous hunk in _extract_diff_hunk(); (4) Stack-based unclosed JSON repair preserving all nested openers and stripping trailing escape backslashes; (5) Bounded linear bailout checks in _extract_balanced_json(); (6) Restricting cd stripping strictly to sandbox roots (RE_SAFE_CD_COMMAND); (7) State-machine diff parsing preserving '---'/'+++' lines inside hunk bodies; (8) Capped AST candidate evaluation (max_ast_parses) in _extract_ast_python_calls(); (9) Rejecting '..' traversal path components in path normalization and shell-to-write conversions; (10) Standalone markdown Python/Bash code block auto-capture (Format 7 & 8) routing to exec_python/run_command; (11) Safe shell file-mutation conversion (echo/cat heredoc -> write_file, python -c -> exec_python); (12) Monotonic line-number gutter detection and stripping in _strip_line_number_gutters(); (13) Ling/Flint/Hermes XML tag extractions; (14) Type-safe old_str/new_str list joining and rejection of boolean falsy strings.
PRIORITIZE: (1) Precompiled regex re-use and avoiding redundant string copies during payload normalization.
DO NOT SACRIFICE: Parser resilience across Hermes, DSML, XML, and markdown formats.

Specialized optimization directives for ai-agent.py (Main CLI Runtime, REPL Loop & Command Dispatcher).
DO NOT FLAG: (1) Zero-fork load_env_file() reading ~/.config/py-agent/.env; (2) Transient terminal prompt cursor repositioning escapes in _clear_transient_status(); (3) Readline history hook configuration; (4) SQLite read-only URI connections in workspace_db_counts(); (5) Non-destructive merge in ensure_clean_agent_dir() preserving existing .agent/history.md; (6) Independent isolated try-blocks for sub-agent worktree and session lock cleanup in clean_exit(); (7) os.chdir() verification before updating workspace path state; (8) Requiring '/' prefix for single-letter commands in RE_THINK_BIN; (9) Rolling back dangling user turn in chat_history when stream_response fails or aborts; (10) Lazy _load_agent_modules() in run_matching_search() keeping shell hooks sub-millisecond; (11) Readline auto-run suggestion prefilling via sanitized RE_AUTO_RUN regex ([a-zA-Z0-9_.:#/-]+) for index-map commands; (12) Short-circuited profile resolution (d.get('profile') or resolve_default_profile(...)) to avoid eager model server probes.
PRIORITIZE: (1) Fast-path query regex matching in main REPL loop; (2) Efficient session lock sweep logic avoiding unnecessary process probes.
DO NOT SACRIFICE: Clean terminal exit hygiene or sub-agent git worktree cleanup.

Specialized optimization directives for CLI visualizers (Media player, Stopwatch).
PRIORITIZE: (1) Replacing math-heavy trigonometric recalculations per frame with lookup arrays; (2) Single-buffer stdout flushing using terminal alternate screens; (3) Reducing line count in ASCII banner matrices.

Global Python Optimization Policy:
PRIORITIZE: (1) Making less lines do more using modern Python 3.10+ idioms (structural pattern matching, dictionary unions, comprehensions); (2) Moving heavy imports inside functions if they are not needed on the instant-start CLI path; (3) Replacing manual loops with built-in standard library utilities (itertools, collections).
DO NOT INTRODUCE: Third-party dependencies (numpy, Cython, asyncio frameworks) outside existing py-agent stack.
